A single extraction of espresso marked with rich milk foam.

We serve the traditional, Italian macchiato. Starbucks famously flipped this drink-as-old-as-time on it's head when it re-invented the macchiato as milk, marked with espresso.

1 part Espresso + 1 part Steamed Milk = Cortado

Of Spanish origin, and translating to "cut", the Cortado is the barista's choice. Like a few drops of water in a dram of whiskey, a cortado is many baristas' favorite way to get to the heart of an espresso.

1 part Espresso + 1 part Steamed Milk + 1 part Milk Microfoam = Cappuccino

Flavor Notes: Malty and rich with a mellow, jammy sweetness and subtle accents of plum and raisin.

Jasmine Pearls are a treasure for lovers of floral teas. Delicately sweet and refreshing with a beautiful aromatic finish.

Flavor Notes: Tender tea leaves, hand-rolled and deeply infused with the sweet aroma of jasmine blossoms.
